---
title: "Future observations"
format:
  html:
    code-fold: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

triggerR <- new.env()
source("../R/read_data.R", local = triggerR)

if (!exists("trigger_tidy")) trigger_tidy <- triggerR$read_tidy()
```

## Future observations

Dates after today are identified in UTC.

```{r}
observation_future <- trigger_tidy |>
  filter(as.Date(minute_ts, tz = "UTC") > as.Date(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC"))
```

## Export

Append newly identified observations, retaining distinct rows.

```{r}
dir.create("../data", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
path <- "data/future_observations.csv.gz"

archive <- if (file.exists(path)) {
  readr::read_csv(path, col_types = readr::cols(
    userId = readr::col_character(), minute_ts = readr::col_datetime()
  ), show_col_types = FALSE)
} else observation_future[0, ]

bind_rows(archive, observation_future) |>
  distinct() |>
  readr::write_csv(path)
```

## Summary

```{r}
observation_future |>
  pivot_longer(-c(userId, minute_ts), names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "value", values_drop_na = TRUE) |>
  group_by(variable) |>
  summarise(
    observations_n = n(),
    participants_n = n_distinct(userId),
    first_date = min(as.Date(minute_ts, tz = "UTC")),
    last_date = max(as.Date(minute_ts, tz = "UTC")),
    min = min(value), max = max(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
